beats.en: Welcome to Lesson 5. We now move to the second grammar skill: Form, Structure, and Sense.
beats.ko: 5강에 오신 걸 환영해요. 이제 두 번째 문법 유형인 Form, Structure, and Sense로 넘어가요.
beats.zh: 欢迎来到第5课。现在进入第二个语法技能：Form, Structure, and Sense。

beats.en: The most tested rule here is subject verb agreement. A singular subject takes a singular verb, and a plural subject takes a plural verb.
beats.ko: 여기서 가장 많이 나오는 규칙은 주어와 동사의 수 일치예요. 단수 주어에는 단수 동사, 복수 주어에는 복수 동사를 써요.
beats.zh: 这里考得最多的规则是主谓一致。单数主语配单数动词，复数主语配复数动词。

beats.en: 'The bird sings.' 'The birds sing.' Notice that the singular verb is the one with the s.
beats.ko: 'The bird sings.' 'The birds sing.' 단수 동사 쪽에 s가 붙는다는 점을 기억하세요.
beats.zh: The bird sings. The birds sing. 注意：单数动词才带 s。

beats.en: The rule is easy. The hard part is finding the real subject. The SAT hides it in long sentences.
beats.ko: 규칙은 쉬워요. 어려운 건 진짜 주어를 찾는 거예요. SAT는 긴 문장 속에 주어를 숨겨요.
beats.zh: 规则很简单，难的是找到真正的主语。SAT会把它藏在长句子里。

beats.en: Here is the most common trick. 'The list of ingredients in these recipes, blank, long.'
beats.ko: 가장 흔한 속임수예요. 'The list of ingredients in these recipes' 다음 빈칸, 그리고 'long.'
beats.zh: 这是最常见的陷阱：The list of ingredients in these recipes，空格，long。

beats.en: The word right before the blank is 'recipes,' which is plural. So many students choose 'are.'
beats.ko: 빈칸 바로 앞 단어가 복수인 recipes라서 많은 학생이 are를 골라요.
beats.zh: 空格前面的词是复数 recipes，所以很多学生选 are。

beats.en: But 'of ingredients in these recipes' is a prepositional phrase. Cross it out. It can never contain the subject.
beats.ko: 하지만 'of ingredients in these recipes'는 전치사구예요. 지우세요. 전치사구 안에는 주어가 절대 없어요.
beats.zh: 但 of ingredients in these recipes 是介词短语。把它划掉。介词短语里永远不会有主语。

beats.en: What is left? 'The list.' One list, so it is singular. 'The list is long.'
beats.ko: 남은 건 뭐죠? 'The list.' 목록 하나니까 단수예요. 'The list is long.'
beats.zh: 剩下什么？The list。一个清单，所以是单数。The list is long.

beats.en: Other words can also sit between the subject and the verb. Skip them all.
beats.ko: 주어와 동사 사이에는 다른 말도 낄 수 있어요. 전부 건너뛰세요.
beats.zh: 主语和动词之间还会插入其他词。全部跳过。

beats.en: 'Along with,' 'as well as,' and 'together with' do not make the subject plural. 'The director, along with her two assistants, plans the schedule.'
beats.ko: along with, as well as, together with는 주어를 복수로 만들지 않아요. 'The director, along with her two assistants, plans the schedule.'
beats.zh: along with、as well as、together with 不会让主语变成复数。The director, along with her two assistants, plans the schedule.

beats.en: Skip who and that clauses too. 'Researchers who studied the ancient city believe.' Researchers, plural, believe.
beats.ko: who절, that절도 건너뛰세요. 'Researchers who studied the ancient city believe.' 복수인 researchers에 맞춰 believe예요.
beats.zh: who 从句和 that 从句也要跳过。Researchers who studied the ancient city believe. 复数 researchers 配 believe。

beats.en: And skip extra information between commas, from Lesson 3. 'The bridge connects the two towns.'
beats.ko: 3강에서 배운 쉼표 사이의 추가 정보도 건너뛰어요. 'The bridge connects the two towns.'
beats.zh: 第3课学的逗号之间的补充信息也要跳过。The bridge connects the two towns.

beats.en: “The collection of letters written by the poet’s friends ___ now kept in a library in Boston.”
beats.ko: “The collection of letters written by the poet’s friends ___ now kept in a library in Boston.”
beats.zh: “The collection of letters written by the poet’s friends ___ now kept in a library in Boston.”

beats.en: Some words are always singular, even though they feel like many: each, every, everyone, anyone, nobody, either, and neither.
beats.ko: 여럿처럼 느껴져도 항상 단수인 말이 있어요. each, every, everyone, anyone, nobody, either, neither예요.
beats.zh: 有些词虽然感觉像很多，但永远是单数：each、every、everyone、anyone、nobody、either、neither。

beats.en: 'Each of the paintings was restored.' Cross out 'of the paintings,' and 'each' is the subject. Singular.
beats.ko: 'Each of the paintings was restored.' 'of the paintings'를 지우면 주어는 each예요. 단수예요.
beats.zh: Each of the paintings was restored. 划掉 of the paintings，主语是 each，单数。

beats.en: Group nouns like team, committee, and audience are usually singular on the SAT, because they act as one unit.
beats.ko: team, committee, audience 같은 집합명사는 SAT에서 보통 단수예요. 하나의 단위로 움직이니까요.
beats.zh: team、committee、audience 这类集合名词在SAT中通常是单数，因为它们作为一个整体行动。

beats.en: And remember this pair: 'the number of' is singular, but 'a number of' means many, so it is plural.
beats.ko: 그리고 이 짝을 기억하세요. 'the number of'는 단수, 'a number of'는 많다는 뜻이라 복수예요.
beats.zh: 再记住这一对：the number of 是单数，而 a number of 表示很多，所以是复数。

beats.en: Sometimes the subject comes after the verb. With 'there is' and 'there are,' the subject follows the verb.
beats.ko: 주어가 동사 뒤에 오는 경우도 있어요. there is, there are 문장에서는 주어가 동사 뒤에 와요.
beats.zh: 有时主语在动词后面。there is 和 there are 句子里，主语在动词之后。

beats.en: 'There are three reasons for the delay.' The subject is 'reasons,' plural, so 'are.'
beats.ko: 'There are three reasons for the delay.' 주어는 복수인 reasons라서 are예요.
beats.zh: There are three reasons for the delay. 主语是复数 reasons，所以用 are。

beats.en: The SAT also starts sentences with a place phrase: 'Among the exhibits was a rare map of the coast.'
beats.ko: SAT는 장소를 나타내는 구로 문장을 시작하기도 해요. 'Among the exhibits was a rare map of the coast.'
beats.zh: SAT还会用地点短语开头：Among the exhibits was a rare map of the coast.

beats.en: Flip it into normal order: 'A rare map of the coast was among the exhibits.' Now the subject, 'map,' is clearly singular.
beats.ko: 평소 순서로 뒤집어 보세요. 'A rare map of the coast was among the exhibits.' 이제 주어 map이 단수라는 게 분명해요.
beats.zh: 把它改回正常语序：A rare map of the coast was among the exhibits. 现在主语 map 显然是单数。

beats.en: Two subjects joined by 'and' make a plural subject. 'The coach and the captain agree.'
beats.ko: and로 이어진 두 주어는 복수 주어가 돼요. 'The coach and the captain agree.'
beats.zh: 用 and 连接的两个主语构成复数主语。The coach and the captain agree.

beats.en: But with 'or' or 'nor,' the verb matches the subject closer to it.
beats.ko: 하지만 or나 nor로 이어지면 동사는 더 가까운 주어에 맞춰요.
beats.zh: 但如果用 or 或 nor 连接，动词与离它更近的主语一致。

beats.en: 'Either the students or the teacher has the key.' 'Teacher' is closer, so 'has.'
beats.ko: 'Either the students or the teacher has the key.' teacher가 더 가까우니까 has예요.
beats.zh: Either the students or the teacher has the key. teacher 更近，所以用 has。

beats.en: Switch the order, and the verb changes: 'Either the teacher or the students have the key.'
beats.ko: 순서를 바꾸면 동사도 바뀌어요. 'Either the teacher or the students have the key.'
beats.zh: 顺序调换，动词也跟着变：Either the teacher or the students have the key.

beats.en: Let's solve one. First, cross out. 'Of many bird species' is a prepositional phrase. 'That nest on remote islands' is a that clause.
beats.ko: 한 문제 풀어 봐요. 먼저 지우세요. 'of many bird species'는 전치사구, 'that nest on remote islands'는 that절이에요.
beats.zh: 做一道题。先划掉：of many bird species 是介词短语，that nest on remote islands 是 that 从句。

beats.en: What is left? 'The survival.' Survival is one thing, so the subject is singular.
beats.ko: 남은 건 'The survival.' survival은 하나니까 주어는 단수예요.
beats.zh: 剩下什么？The survival。survival 是一件事，所以主语是单数。

beats.en: A, C, and D are all plural verbs. Only B, 'depends,' is singular. The answer is B.
beats.ko: A, C, D는 모두 복수 동사예요. 단수 동사는 B 'depends'뿐이에요. 정답은 B예요.
beats.zh: A、C、D 都是复数动词，只有 B depends 是单数。答案是 B。

beats.en: “Neither the photographs nor the diary ___ the exact date of the expedition.”
beats.ko: “Neither the photographs nor the diary ___ the exact date of the expedition.”
beats.zh: “Neither the photographs nor the diary ___ the exact date of the expedition.”

beats.en: Let's review. To find the real subject, cross out prepositional phrases, who and that clauses, and extra information.
beats.ko: 정리할게요. 진짜 주어를 찾으려면 전치사구, who절과 that절, 추가 정보를 지우세요.
beats.zh: 我们来总结。要找真正的主语，就划掉介词短语、who 和 that 从句以及补充信息。

beats.en: Each, every, everyone, either, neither, and group nouns are singular. 'A number of' is plural.
beats.ko: each, every, everyone, either, neither와 집합명사는 단수예요. 'a number of'는 복수예요.
beats.zh: each、every、everyone、either、neither 和集合名词是单数。a number of 是复数。

beats.en: When the subject comes after the verb, flip the sentence into normal order.
beats.ko: 주어가 동사 뒤에 오면 문장을 평소 순서로 뒤집어 보세요.
beats.zh: 主语在动词后面时，把句子改回正常语序。

beats.en: 'And' makes a plural subject. With 'or' and 'nor,' match the nearer one. Next lesson: verb tense and verb forms. See you in Lesson 6!
beats.ko: and는 복수 주어를 만들고, or와 nor는 가까운 쪽에 맞춰요. 다음은 동사의 시제와 형태예요. 6강에서 만나요!
beats.zh: and 构成复数主语；or 和 nor 与较近的一方一致。下一课：动词时态与形式。第6课见！
